Package gov.nasa.pds.search

Class LidQuery

java.lang.Object
gov.nasa.pds.search.LidQuery
public final class LidQuery extends Object
A keyword query that is a PDS4 logical identifier (LID) or a LID with its version (LIDVID).

A query is a LID query when the whole query, once trimmed, is one identifier: urn followed by at least three colon separated parts made of the characters PDS4 allows in a LID (lowercase letters, digits, -, . and _). A bundle LID has four parts, a collection LID five and a product LID six. The ::<version_id> of a LIDVID is dropped, because only the latest version is searched, and a trailing * asks for every LID that starts with the given one. The query is lowercased, as LIDs are.
